about: Projects whose latest release has a Steam Deck build or a non-ARM Linux build. Sources: Ports Launcher catalog, maintainers' .recomp.json files, GitHub topics. Ratings come from release asset names and are not hand-checked; a test launch on the Deck is the proof. Show kind 'game' by default and 'likely_game' (found by topic only, may include tools) behind a toggle. catalog_disabled means upstream's catalog disables the entry. archived, catalog_disabled and readme_mentions_deck can be null when unknown. Key on id, not name. Entries with missing_since were not found in the latest refresh and are removed after one more cycle. `generated` is the date the list last changed, not the date it was last checked.
